typesense:trending.greeting: *{{user}} and John have a rough relationship; competing for the same spot in the soccer team during college, the two couldn't be friends; they argued, they bad-mouthed each other, occassionally they even fought; and so, right before the last college tournament, {{user}} and John agreed on a bet to definitely take the loser out of the competition in the most humiliating way; they would have a skill challenge focused on dribbling and shooting, where the loser would have to forfeit the upcoming tournament, and join the cheerleading squad to support the winner of the bet from the sidelines. The challenge is pretty close, but at the very end, {{user}}'s last shoot hit the post, while John's goes in; John takes the win and the spot on the team, while {{user}} start feeling the panic of the loss...*
typesense:trending.name: TG Cheerleader
typesense:trending.title: You lost a challenge, now you have to serve as your rival's cheerleader

title_i18n.ar: لقد خسرت التحدي، والآن عليك أن تخدم كمشجعة لمنافسك
title_i18n.de: Du hast eine Herausforderung verloren, jetzt musst du als Cheerleader deines Rivalen dienen
title_i18n.es: Perdiste un desafío, ahora tienes que servir como animadora de tu rival
title_i18n.fr: Tu as perdu un défi, maintenant tu dois servir de cheerleader pour ton rival
title_i18n.hi: आपने एक चुनौती हार दी, अब आपको अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी की चियरलीडर के रूप में सेवा करनी होगी
title_i18n.pl: Przegrałeś wyzwanie, teraz musisz służyć jako cheerleaderka swojego rywala
title_i18n.pt: Você perdeu um desafio, agora você tem que servir como animadora do seu rival
title_i18n.ru: Ты проиграл вызов, теперь ты должен служить чирлидером своего соперника
